Shrines are magical constructs found throughout the World of Eterra.

## Mechanics[]

Shrines can be activated by clicking on them. They confer a variety of exciting effects - such as summoning enemies for you to fight, spawning temporary allies to assist you in combat, and granting powerful, time-limited buffs. Shrines can only be activated once.

The Shrines from each era have their own unique model. Additionally, their appearance will update when they are activated, and again when their duration expires.

## Types of Shrines[]

| Name | Effect |

| Critical Shrine | Grants 100% Critical hit chance for 60s. |

| Experience Shrine | Increases experience gain by 50% for 60s. |

| Haste Shrine | Grants 30% increased Action and Movement Speed for 60s (stacks with other sources of Haste). |

| Shrine of Wealth | Drops piles of gold. |

| Stunning Shrine | Grants 200% increased Stun Chance and Stun Duration for 60s. |

| Reflective Shrine | Grants 300% damage reflection. |

| Water Shrine | Grants 100% increased mana regeneration and cooldown Recovery Speed. |

| Shrine of Shards | Drops random Affix Shards. |

| Golden Shrine | Spawns Golden Scorpions, each of which drops a rare item on death. |

| Beekeeper's Shrine | Summons 12 fragile bee companions. |

| Shrine of the Ice Beetle | Summons a temporary Ice Beetle companion. It can spit freezing projectiles at enemies. |

| Shrine of the Frozen Hive | Summons 3-5 temporary Ice Beetle companions, which can spit freezing projectiles at enemies. |

| Shrine of Legends | Drops a Unique item. |
